main_body: double street lamppost with stone base
top_band: none (crossbar at rows 3-4 is a 2px dark grey/black bar; lanterns at rows 6-12 have 1px grey caps; stone base at rows 31-35 is a stepped plinth)
evidence: The lamppost is drawn in pure front elevation: the horizontal crossbar (rows 3-4) is a 2px flat line with only 1px lighter grey above 1px dark grey, the hanging lanterns (rows 6-12) show no visible top planes, and the central pole has a 2px wide finial at rows 0-1. Only the small stepped stone plinth at the bottom (rows 31-39) has any horizontal step.

style.evidence: This is a native Beodeul lamppost piece: the stone base has 5 grey steps with weathered stone detailing, the brass lanterns have 4-5 warm yellow/ochre steps, and dark material tones are used for edges without harsh black sticker outlines.
